info.title: SURAKSHA API
info.description: Flood evacuation and rescue coordination (Darbhanga, Bihar). Coordinates in GeoJSON are [longitude, latitude]. Errors: { error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }. Realtime events via Socket.IO at /socket.io.

status.description: closed closes the shelter; open re-opens it. near_capacity/full are always derived from occupancy.

routeRecordId.description: Persisted route record; subscribe to socket room route:<id> for invalidation

LatLngInput.description: WGS84 point inside the Bihar service area

verified.description: Admin only: record as already verified

appliedRoadStatus.description: Admin only, requires verified=true: road status applied to the snapped road edge

reopenRoad.description: Set the linked road back to open (skipped if another verified hazard still affects it)

status.description: resolved/cancelled close the incident (cancelling any active mission); new re-opens a closed incident. Field progress (assigned, en_route, on_site) is driven by mission status.

MissionStatusRequest.description: assigned → accepted → en_route → on_site → completed; cancelled from any non-terminal state

schema.description: true: only shelters accepting people (open/near_capacity with free capacity)

parameters.description: true: only shelters accepting people (open/near_capacity with free capacity)
parameters.name: available

schema.description: Comma-separated facilities that must all be present, e.g. medical,water

parameters.description: Comma-separated facilities that must all be present, e.g. medical,water
parameters.name: facility

get.summary: Get a route record and its validity
List road edges (bbox/status; format=geojson for a FeatureCollection)

patch.summary: Change road status (bumps graph version, invalidates routes) (admin)

post.summary: Report a hazard (citizen reports start unverified)

schema.description: Comma-separated verification statuses (staff only; public sees verified)

parameters.description: Comma-separated verification statuses (staff only; public sees verified)
parameters.name: status

patch.summary: Verify or reject a hazard, optionally applying a road status (admin)

post.summary: Submit an SOS (Idempotency-Key supported; duplicate returns 200 with the original)

get.summary: Get an SOS (requester, admin or responder)

post.summary: Re-run priority rules (waiting time, nearby hazards) (admin)
Assign a team to an incident (cancels any active mission) (admin)

schema.description: Admin only; responders always see their own team

parameters.description: Admin only; responders always see their own team
parameters.name: teamId

get.summary: Readiness (DB gates; routing engine reported separately)
